title: Release Train Weekly Prep - Go/No-Go
body:
Meeting: Release Train Weekly Prep (Go/No-Go)
Date: 2026-03-04
Time: 10:00-10:30 PT
Location: Zoom / #release-train
Owner (doc): Amelia Wong

Purpose:
- Quick sync to confirm launch readiness and surface last-minute risks for the upcoming release window.
- Capture go/no-go decision inputs and assign owners for follow-ups.

Attendees (planned):
- Release lead: Amelia Wong
- SRE: Noah Kim
- Serving runtime: Samir Patel
- Product: Priya Kapoor
- QA: Jordan Lee
- On-call rota listed in slack thread #release-oncall

Agenda:
1) Quick status round (2-3 min each): infra, runtime, QA, product
2) Go/No-Go checklist review (main owner calls out any non-green items)
3) Blockers & risks (identify mitigations + owners)
4) Action items with owners and due times
5) Final decision signals & contingency plan

Go/No-Go Checklist (green = ready, amber = caution, red = block)
- Infra capacity: reserved nodes provisioned for Dedicated and hosted burst - Owner: Noah Kim - STATUS: green
- Model artifact pinned and verified (hash & inference test) - Owner: Samir Patel - STATUS: green
- Canary deploy + smoke tests in staging (latency, error-rate) - Owner: Jordan Lee - STATUS: amber (2 flakey tests)
- DB / config migration plan tested in dry-run - Owner: Priya Kapoor - STATUS: green
- Security review & KMS key rotation completed - Owner: Security team (Ana Morales) - STATUS: green
- Rollback plan tested and documented - Owner: Release Train - STATUS: green
- Alerts and runbooks updated for new endpoints - Owner: SRE Docs - STATUS: amber (missing runbook link)

Key Blockers / Risks
- Flaky smoke tests in staging (PROJ-4890): two tests intermittently exceed latency SLO -> risk of false negatives during canary. Mitigation: increase retry tolerance in smoke harness and run two consecutive passes before canary promotion. Owner: Jordan Lee, due: 2026-03-04 12:00 PT.
- Missing runbook link in alert pages -> on-call might lack quick steps if we see new error mode. Mitigation: SRE to publish runbook and post link in #release-train. Owner: Noah Kim, due: 2026-03-04 11:30 PT.
- Model quantization variance: minor quality regression on a small prompt set (detected by evals). Mitigation: pin to previous quantized variant for initial rollout; schedule quick A/B eval during canary. Owner: Samir Patel, due: 2026-03-04 13:00 PT.

Decisions Needed from Meeting
- Approve canary progression criteria (two consecutive smoke passes + no new SLO breaches in 30m window). Propose: yes unless any red items above.
- Approve temporary pin to previous quantized model variant if A/B evals show >2% quality drop.

Action Items (explicit)
- Jordan Lee - Investigate flaky smoke tests in PROJ-4890, update test harness to require two consecutive passes - Due 2026-03-04 12:00 PT.
- Noah Kim - Publish alert runbook and post link in #release-train; confirm page with on-call - Due 2026-03-04 11:30 PT.
- Samir Patel - Prepare fallback artifcat (previous quantized model) and document pin instructions in the release notes - Due 2026-03-04 13:00 PT.
- Priya Kapoor - Confirm DB migration dry-run logs are uploaded to CONFLUENCE and share link in meeting thread - Due 2026-03-04 11:00 PT.
- Amelia Wong - Hold final go/no-go check at 14:00 PT and publish decision to stakeholders; update release playbook with any last-minute notes - Due 2026-03-04 14:05 PT.

Contingency / Rollback Plan
- If canary shows regression > allowed threshold or new critical alerts appear, immediate rollback to previous deployment (automated rollback toggled by Release Lead). Runbook: rollback steps + contact list in CONFLUENCE://release/RT-2026-03 (ensure link present).

Notes & Context / Links
- Smoke test failures logged under PROJ-4890 (Jira).
- Canary metric dashboard: internal link (dashboard/release-rt-2026).
- PR with model pin: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/987 (merge status: open).
- Previous release retros: CONFLUENCE://retros/2026-02-release (lessons about rollbacks).

Parking lot / Items to follow separately
- Postmortem template tweak for model quantization regressions (owner: Research team).
- Add a pre-canary traffic ramp doc for Dedicated customers (owner: Product Ops).

Meeting outcome (to be filled after final check)
- Final decision: (GO / NO-GO)
- Notes from final check:

---
Revision history:
- 2026-03-02: initial draft (Amelia Wong)
- 2026-03-04: updated statuses and action items after infra sync (Amelia Wong)
summary: Prep notes for weekly release train: checklist review, blockers, action items, owners and due times. Primary issues: flaky smoke tests (PROJ-4890) and missing runbook link. Final go/no-go decision scheduled for 14:00 PT.
